description: This file declares the PackageManager class, which manages plugin lifecycle, JSON-RPC communication, and package download/install notifications within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It includes interface references, nested notification handler class, and method declarations for initialization, deinitialization, and information retrieval.

classes.name: PackageManager
classes.description: Main plugin class managing package operations and notifications within the WPEFramework plugin system.

classes.name: NotificationHandler
classes.description: Nested class handling remote connection and package download/install notifications, interfacing with the parent PackageManager.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the plugin with the provided shell service.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Deinitializes the plugin, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: Information
methods.description: Returns plugin information as a string.
